name: The Ruins of Kel'Theril
label: Quest
description: The Ruins of Kel'Theril: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The story behind Kel'Theril is one of a cursed race, bound to the place where they attempted an unfortunate ritual...

The highborne that you will find there once stole a sacred artifact, believing that they could siphon its power for themselves, becoming even more powerful. In their efforts, the relic shattered in a huge explosion, driving the pieces below the ice of the lake...
Speak with Jaron Stoneshaper if you'd like to learn more; he has recently visited the area and can tell you more.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well, sure, I can tell you more about Kel'Theril. Mind you now, I'm no historian, but I can tell ya about what I saw there...
